text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Management Systems Unit (MSU) going international. Government-owned agency teams up with information technology firms to set up international training centre in Malta.
- Prime Minister Edward Fenech Adami is in Britain on private visit.
- Malta celebrates Victory Day. The day recalls Malta's victory in the great siege by the Turks in 1565 and World War Two.
- Five arrested after police found substantial amount of ecstasy drugs.
- Exports from new technopark expected to top $50 million in three years.
- Government realising VAT is unfair, opposition Labour Party Deputy Leader George Abela says. The party has promised to remove VAT, should it be elected in elections due by mid-1997.
- Dockyard town Senglea wins annual Harbour Regatta.
